```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install cargo-deb
        run: cargo install cargo-deb

      - name: Build .deb package
        run: cargo deb

      - name: Find .deb file
        id: deb
        run: echo "deb_file=$(find target/debian -name '*.deb' | head -n 1)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Publish to PPA
        uses: pypa/ppa-publish@v1
        with:
          ppa-key: ${{ secrets.PPA_KEY }}
          ppa-repo: ${{ secrets.PPA_REPO }}
          deb-file: ${{ steps.deb.outputs.deb_file }}
```
